questions: Are you experiencing discomfort or pain in your eyes right now?
Have you noticed any blurry or reduced vision with this issue?
Did this problem begin within the last two days?
Is this discomfort affecting both of your eyes equally?
Have you had any eye redness, swelling, or discharge recently?
Did you come into contact with any irritants, like chemicals, wind, or debris, before this started?
Is this discomfort getting worse as time passes?
